360s simulation time loop and model reference frame camera synchronization

cases.title: Picking

Screen-space event handling and depth-aware feature picking

cases.title: Clamp Model to Ground

HeightReference (CLAMP_TO_GROUND, RELATIVE_TO_GROUND, NONE)
Ground anchor reference pin alignment

cases.title: Camera
requirements: Camera navigation gallery with San Diego flyTo, Mount St. Helens heading/pitch/roll, view rectangle, and lookAt
Orientation quat/euler angles and altitude positioning

cases.title: Time Dependent Path Graphics
requirements: Dynamic flight trajectory with 4 waypoints across 180s
leadTime and trailTime path portions with glow and outline materials
Sampled position interpolation and time-dependent corridor path

cases.title: CZML

Satellites (Geoeye1, ISS), facility, territory polygon, and ground vehicle routes

3D MilkTruck model, dynamic fuel readout label, and progressive route corridor

cases.title: Relative Paths

Two satellites relative to Earth and each other, ground vehicle and helicopter relative trajectories

cases.title: Time Dynamic Wheels

Speedometer readout label in km/hr and runway flight path corridor

cases.title: Clustering

EntityCluster support with billboard and label clustering modes

cases.title: GeoJSON simplestyle

Marker symbols, route stroke/strokeWidth, and district fill/fillOpacity

cases.title: GeoJSON and TopoJSON

Default styling, basic styling (hotpink stroke/pink fill), population extrusion, and random coloring

cases.title: KML
requirements: KML / KMZ data source features across multiple geographic datasets
Global facilities, GDP per capita extruded polygons, and gx bike tour track

webSceneNativeScope: HTML Overlays, Resolution Scaling and Hello World native smokes cover the shared globe/projection kernel; their DOM/DPR behavior is browser-only. Offline native smoke loads real local TMS images.
acceptanceScope: All case-specific source statements, inputs, geometry/entities, visibility groups, browser DOM/events/resolution controls and camera behavior in the fixed sources; not a pixel-exact Cesium renderer or implementation of all Viewer widgets.
